Project Overview
This project is an application that maximizes the user experience by leveraging a modern web technology stack.

Core Features
1. User Authentication and Authorization Management
- JWT-based Authentication System
- Role-based Access Control (RBAC)

2. Real-Time Data Synchronization
- Real-Time Updates via WebSocket
- ​​Optimistic UI Updates

3. Responsive Design
- Mobile-First Approach
- Dark Mode Support

Technology Stack
• Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14, TypeScript
• Styling: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
• State Management: Zustand, React Query
• Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL
• DevOps: Docker, AWS ECS, GitHub Actions

✅ 60% Improvement in Page Loading Speed
✅ 95% User Satisfaction
✅ Over 10,000 Monthly Active Users
✅ 85% Code Coverage

Technical Challenges and Solutions
We optimized state management patterns to efficiently handle complex business logic, and significantly improved performance through caching strategies.

Lessons Learned
- The importance of scalable architecture design
- The value of user feedback
- Team collaboration and code review culture
